_provenance.purpose: Curated set of genes with well-established PROMOTER-HYPERMETHYLATION silencing in breast cancer, for the MOGFormer rho_pred specificity (§3.2) and sign-sanity (§4) tests.
selection_rules: Pan-breast-cancer silencing (NOT restricted to a single subtype).
Subtype-conditional / subtype-DEFINING silencers excluded (ESR1, PGR, BRCA1).
Every gene verified present in the 433-gene MOGFormer universe (else unaddressable).
Promoter hypermethylation -> transcriptional repression is the documented mechanism (not gene-body / enhancer effects).
_provenance.note_on_LumA: The encoder was pretrained on FULL BRCA, so pan-BC silencers are the right sign-gate reference regardless of the LumA probe cohort. For the LumA-cohort specificity test, pan-BC (non-subtype) silencers are the correct choice; ESR1/PGR/BRCA1 would leak subtype identity.

caveats.CDH1: Promoter methylation occurs across BC but is enriched in lobular carcinoma; keep, but flag if it behaves as an outlier.
caveats.TWIST1: Silencing well-documented but more variable/EMT-context-dependent; placed in tier-2/optional.

sign_gate._use: §4 sign-sanity gate. If ANY of these does not read rho_pred < 0, STOP: the sign is flipped.

rationale.RASSF1: RASSF1A promoter hypermethylation is the single most frequently methylated locus in breast cancer, essentially pan-subtype.
rationale.SCGB3A1: HIN-1; canonical breast promoter-hypermethylation-silenced gene, very high methylation frequency.
rationale.CDKN2A: p16INK4a promoter hypermethylation, classic tumor-suppressor silencing.

curated_silenced._use: §3.2 specificity test (curated vs all-other-genes, one-sided Mann-Whitney, expect more negative).

rationale.PYCARD: TMS1/ASC; methylation-silenced in breast, classic apoptosis-linked TSG.
rationale.APC: APC promoter-1A hypermethylation is frequent in breast carcinoma.
rationale.GSTP1: Detoxification gene silenced by promoter hypermethylation in breast (and prostate).
rationale.SFRP1: Secreted Wnt antagonist; very frequent promoter hypermethylation, poor-prognosis associated.
rationale.SFRP2: Wnt antagonist, frequently hypermethylated in breast.
rationale.WIF1: Wnt inhibitory factor 1; promoter hypermethylation across BC.
rationale.RARRES1: TIG1; retinoid-responsive TSG silenced by promoter hypermethylation.
rationale.ID4: Promoter hypermethylation reported in breast, prognosis-associated.
rationale.CCND2: Cyclin D2 paradoxical promoter-hypermethylation silencing in breast.

excluded_subtype_conditional._use: Documented as EXCLUDED to honor the spec. Do not place in the curated denominator.

genes.BRCA1: Promoter hypermethylation strongly basal/TNBC-enriched; usable for pan-BC sign gate only, NOT LumA specificity.

driver_amplicon_contrast._use: §3.3 known-locus curves. AMPLIFIED oncogenes: expected NULL or non-silencing methylation coupling; serve as a biological contrast to the silenced set and connect to the CNV-burden axis (§3.5).
